name: tinker-agent-pet
description: Browse, install and run Petdex agent pets in Tinker

tinker.name: Agent Pet
tinker.description: Browse Petdex pets and run an animated desktop companion

zh-CN.name: Agent 桌宠
zh-CN.description: 浏览 Petdex 宠物并在桌面启用动画桌宠

play_action.description: Play a named animation on the currently enabled desktop pet. Requires an active pet window. Pass loop=true to keep repeating until another play_action call.

action.description: Animation to play on the active pet

loop.description: If true, keep looping this animation until the next play_action (e.g. stop/idle). Defaults to false (play once, then return to idle when that setting is on).

list_actions.description: List available pet animations and the currently enabled pet.

get_status.description: Get whether a desktop pet is enabled and its runtime settings.
